reason: The README describes a SkillHub marketplace plugin whose primary purpose is searching, browsing, installing, listing, uninstalling, and updating skills and DSH plugins through a web interface and agent tools. It performs network requests, writes local skill files, and can execute host-level plugin installation and restart operations.

summaries.zh: SkillHub 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中搜索、浏览、查看详情并安装或管理技能与 DSH 插件。
summaries.en: SkillHub lets users search, browse, inspect, install, update, and manage skills and DSH plugins in DeepSeek Harness.

capabilities: Searches public SkillHub APIs for skills and plugins
Displays skill metadata, details, versions, and evaluations
Downloads and installs skill archives into a local skills directory
Lists and uninstalls locally installed skills
Installs DSH plugins into the current web profile
Checks for and installs updates from GitHub releases
Writes plugin configuration and installed files locally
Can restart the hosting web process after installation or updates
